body.statement: For every \(m\ge1\) and \(h\in H_m\), the class \(\mathcal M_{m,h}\) is nonempty. Over this class, the sharp identified set for \(\mathbb E_Q[Y(1)-Y(0)]\) is exactly \([L_m(h),U_m(h)]\), with \(L_m(h)=-49/495+(11/(80m))\sum_{j=1}^{m}|h_{0,j}|\) and \(U_m(h)=49/495-(11/(80m))\sum_{j=1}^{m}|h_{1,j}|\). Each endpoint is attained by a completion whose missing potential-outcome means lie strictly inside \((0,2)\) in the normalized experiment. The displayed pair is equivalent to the specialization of Lemma 1 and Theorem 1 of LannersRudinVolfovskyParikh2025 to \(P_{m,h}\), \(\rho=\gamma=1/5\), and support \([0,2]\).
body.justification: This embeds the statistical experiment in the published data-fusion sensitivity model and verifies that the hard endpoints are causal rather than synthetic functionals.
body.gap: LannersRudinVolfovskyParikh2025 proves the general max/min formulas; this theorem specializes them and adds uniform interior endpoint-attaining completions for the paired cube.
body.consumer: It makes every interval theorem directly interpretable for the Project STAR sensitivity endpoints and the associated implementation.
